# Joey Fraser

> Joey Fraser is the Head of Risk Operations at Fragile, a hardware-subscription platform powering recurring-revenue programs for global technology brands. Based in San Francisco.

Joey leads payment and asset recovery strategy at Fragile (parent of the Whim subscription program). His background spans risk operations, recovery analytics, and consumer-finance operations at scale. He occasionally writes about operations, risk, and the infrastructure that makes hardware subscriptions work.
